fields.route: rules = caught by Stage 1 regex; llm = falls through to Stage 2 LLM

fixtures.text: Founder put personal savings into business account

fixtures.text: Initial business funding from the company director
fixtures.note: 'funded' matches ownerFunds rule

fixtures.text: Equity raised from managing director for expansion
fixtures.note: 'equity raised' does not match 'equity injection'; LLM must classify

fixtures.text: R200000 from owner placed into operating account
fixtures.note: 'placed into' is not in ownerFunds regex; LLM must infer

fixtures.text: Owner injected R80000 cash for startup costs
fixtures.note: 'injected' alone is not in ownerFunds regex (only 'equity injection' and 'capital injection' are)

fixtures.text: Owner infused cash from personal account into business
fixtures.note: 'infused' is not in any regex; LLM must classify from context

fixtures.text: Seed money received from founding partner
fixtures.note: Seed funding phrasing; no rule keyword present

fixtures.text: MD loaned R30000 to cover payroll shortfall
fixtures.note: 'MD' does not match 'director'; 'loaned' does not match \bloan\b; LLM must infer

fixtures.text: CEO provided advance to business for cash flow
fixtures.note: CEO is not 'director' or 'shareholder'; advance is repayable

fixtures.text: Managing member bridge loan to the company
fixtures.note: 'loan to the company' matches \bloan\b.*(to|into).*(business|company)

fixtures.text: Owner lent money for stock purchase to be repaid
fixtures.note: 'lent money' without director/shareholder context; \bloan\b not present

fixtures.text: Director's personal funds lent to the business for 3 months
fixtures.note: 'director' + 'lent' matches (director|shareholder).*(lent|loaned|advanced)

fixtures.text: Shareholder advance for operating cash flow requirements
fixtures.note: 'shareholder advance' — 'advance' not in (lent|loaned|advanced); no 'loan' keyword; LLM must infer repayable nature

fixtures.text: Repayable amount advanced by business owner to company
fixtures.note: 'repayable' signals a loan; no rule keyword matches this phrasing

fixtures.text: R50000 from founding director to be repaid over 12 months
fixtures.note: 'director' present but no loan/lent/loaned/advanced keyword; LLM must identify repayable intent

fixtures.text: Funds swept to fixed deposit account end of month
fixtures.note: Account sweep — no 'transfer' keyword; LLM must identify internal movement

fixtures.text: Monthly reallocation between operating accounts
fixtures.note: 'between accounts' without 'transfer' word; LLM must classify as internal movement

fixtures.text: Cash moved from current account to savings account
fixtures.note: 'cash moved from' — does not match \bmove(d)? funds\b; 'moved' is followed by 'from' not 'funds'

fixtures.text: Internal account transfer to reserve fund
fixtures.note: 'transfer' keyword matches rule directly

fixtures.text: Year-end surplus sweep to investment vehicle
fixtures.note: 'surplus sweep' is a common SA phrasing for internal moves; no rule keywords

fixtures.text: First provisional tax installment to SARS
fixtures.note: 'installment' is not in (payment|paid|settlement|remittance); LLM must classify

fixtures.text: PAYE for October payroll run submitted
fixtures.note: 'submitted' is not in (payment|paid|settlement|remittance); LLM must handle

fixtures.text: UIF contribution to the Department of Labour
fixtures.note: UIF is a mandatory statutory contribution; not in regex pattern; LLM must classify

fixtures.text: Income tax paid to SARS for the year
fixtures.note: 'income tax' + 'paid' matches taxPayment rule exactly

fixtures.text: SDL skills development levy charge
fixtures.note: SDL is a statutory levy; 'skills development levy' not in regex; LLM must classify

fixtures.text: Invested in a new digital marketing campaign
fixtures.note: EDGE CASE: 'invested in' matches notOwnerFunds negative pattern → null → LLM. Must return expense, not capital

fixtures.text: Capital expenditure for new office furniture
fixtures.note: EDGE CASE: 'capital expenditure' matches notOwnerFunds → null → LLM. Must return expense, not capital

fixtures.text: Bank loan repayment to FNB
fixtures.note: EDGE CASE: Business bank loan repayment (not owner loan); 'loan to FNB' does not match \bloan\b.*(to|into).*(business|company)

fixtures.text: Refund from supplier for cancelled order
fixtures.note: EDGE CASE: Supplier refund reverses an expense — recorded as income per SPEC.md refund rule

fixtures.text: Bad debt recovery from former client
fixtures.note: EDGE CASE: Recovery of previously written-off debt is income

fixtures.text: TERS Covid relief payment received from government
fixtures.note: EDGE CASE: Relief grant — 'TERS' not in tax regex; 'payment received' is ambiguous; LLM must classify as income

fixtures.text: Dividend income received from subsidiary company
fixtures.note: EDGE CASE: Investment income from subsidiary; not a capital transaction

fixtures.text: Depreciation charge on company delivery vehicles
fixtures.note: EDGE CASE: Non-cash expense still affects P&L; LLM must recognise depreciation as an expense

fixtures.text: BEE compliance audit and certification fee
fixtures.note: EDGE CASE: South African-specific regulatory cost; no generic keywords to guide rules
